Name: Daily Adventures
Author: seekmisery
Description:
[size=5]Daily Adventures
[/size]
[b]Adds optional daily quests and small adventures that fit naturally into Stardew Valley.[/b]
Ever wish there was a little more to do each morning when you wake up on the farm? Daily Adventures gives you 1–3 randomized quests every day — gathering resources, catching fish, or running errands for the townsfolk. Nothing game-changing, just a gentle nudge to explore the valley and earn some extra gold along the way.
[line]
[heading]Features[/heading]
[b]38 handcrafted quests[/b] across three types:
[list]
[*][b]Gathering[/b] (18 quests) — Chop wood, mine ore, dig clay, forage seasonal plants, hunt for gems, collect mushrooms, and more. Objectives scale from quick errands (3 spring wild plants) to satisfying challenges (100 wood).[/*]
[*][b]Fishing[/b] (7 quests) — Catch any fish or go after seasonal catches. Whether you're a casual angler or chasing the Master Angler title, there's something for you.[/*]
[*][b]Delivery[/b] (13 quests) — Bring items to 12 different villagers: Robin needs wood, Harvey wants his coffee, Jas is craving ice cream, Penny would love a diamond… Each delivery feels like a natural part of valley life.[/*]
[/list][b]Adventure Board UI[/b] — Press [b]F7[/b] to open the Adventure Board at any time. See your active quests, progress bars, rewards, and lifetime stats — all in one clean panel.
[b]Smart quest rotation[/b] — Quests are filtered by season and year, so you won't see winter foraging tasks in spring. The mod avoids repeating recent quests to keep things fresh.
[b]Automatic progress tracking[/b] — No need to "turn in" quests manually. Chop a tree? Your wood-gathering quest updates instantly. Catch a fish? Counted. Give a gift to the right NPC? Done.
[b]Randomized rewards[/b] — Each quest awards gold (scaling with difficulty) or useful items. You never know exactly what you'll get.
[b]Multi-day quests[/b] — Some adventures give you 2–3 days to complete, so you're not rushed.
[b]Configurable quest count[/b] — Want just 1 quest per day? Or the full 3? Edit 
[code]config.json[/code] to set your preferred number (1–3).
[b]Save-safe[/b] — All progress is saved with your game file. Uninstall cleanly at any time.
[line]
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (version 4.0.0 or later)[/*]
[*]Download the mod and extract the ZIP into your 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI[/*]
[*]Press [b]F7[/b] in-game to open the Adventure Board[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] 1.6+[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Works in single-player. Multiplayer has not been tested.[/*]
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods. No vanilla files are replaced.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Console Commands (for testing/debugging)[/heading]
[table][tr][th]Command[/th]
[th]Description[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]da_status[/code][/td]
[td]Shows all active adventures and their progress[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]da_complete <slot>[/code][/td]
[td]Force-completes an adventure by slot number[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][code]da_reset[/code][/td]
[td]Clears all adventures and generates new ones[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][line]
[heading]Localization[/heading]
The mod is fully available in [b]English[/b] and [b]Russian[/b] (Русский). The quest names, descriptions, and all UI text are localized.
Want to add your own language? Copy 
[code]i18n/default.json[/code]rename it to your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]language code[/url] (e.g.),
[code]pt-BR.json[/code]and translate the strings.
[line]
[heading]FAQ[/heading]
[b]Q: Can I add this mod to an existing save?[/b] A: Yes! It's completely safe to add mid-playthrough. New adventures will appear the next morning.
[b]Q: Can I remove the mod from an existing save?[/b] A: Yes. The mod stores its data in SMAPI's save system. Removing the mod won't corrupt your save — the adventure data simply won't be loaded.
[b]Q: How many quests do I get per day?[/b] A: By default, 1–3 quests are generated each morning (randomized). You can set a fixed number in the config file.
[b]Q: Do quests expire?[/b] A: Yes. Each quest has a duration (1–3 days). Expired quests are removed and replaced with new ones.
[line]
[heading]Source Code[/heading]
This mod is open source. Contributions, bug reports, and suggestions are welcome!
